lot_size_history.note: NSE-rationalized standard lot from Oct-2015 onward; 75 was the standing Nifty lot size for years prior to 2021 lot reduction
Reduced to 50 in Oct-2021 as Nifty crossed 17000 and contract value drifted above retail-friendly band
Brief 25-lot regime in 2024 as Nifty hit new highs and contract value ballooned; reduced for retail access
SEBI ₹15L minimum contract value rule; weekly contracts from 20-Nov-2024, long-dated transitioned 26-Dec-2024
NSE reduced lot size Nov-2025 as index exceeded ₹20L upper band; effective for contracts expiring Jan-2026+

expiry_day_history.note: Weekly options launched Feb-2019 with Thursday expiry; last Thursday expiry 28-Aug-2025
SEBI standardisation: NSE moved from Thursday to Tuesday from 2-Sep-2025

notes: SPAN component for a defined-risk spread (iron condor): NSE SPAN scenario matrices run 16 price+vol scenarios.
For a hedged spread the worst-case scenario is bounded by the spread width. SPAN ≈ wing_width × lot_size.
ELM (Extreme Loss Margin) is charged on the notional value of EACH short index option leg.
For an iron condor with 2 short legs: total ELM = elm_rate_per_leg × spot × lot_size × 2.
Expiry-day additional ELM applies only when holding short options on the actual expiry day.
This strategy exits on Monday; Nifty expiry is Tuesday — so expiry-day ELM never applies.

elm_history.note: 2% of notional value per short index option leg. NSE Clearing official rate — unchanged since inception of index derivatives.

expiry_day_elm_history.note: No additional expiry-day ELM before SEBI circular Oct-2024
SEBI circular SEBI/HO/MRD/MRD-PoD-2/P/CIR/2024/116 (Oct-2024): +2% ELM on short index options on expiry day. Not applicable to this strategy (exits Monday, expiry Tuesday).

margin_rate_history.note: Pre peak-margin era — SEBI circular not yet in full effect; blended SPAN+ELM effective rate for short strangle.
Full peak-margin enforcement from Jan-2022. 12% of notional per strangle leg (combined).

Lot size reduced to 65 from Jan-2026. Effective combined SPAN+ELM rate calibrated to Zerodha basket margin for 3-strangle (6 legs, 1 lot each, Nifty ~23500): Rs6,04,267 actual vs Rs5,72,813 at 12.5% — implied 13.19%, rounded to 13.2%.
